item.title: The shelf
item.description: Collections are lines you already run: a shell line, an @endpoint call, or an @tool call. Collections on the rail, or Cmd+Shift+B (Ctrl+Shift+B on Windows and Linux), opens the shelf in the terminal column and hides the prompt. Press the shortcut again, or Esc, to return.

item.title: Run as a runbook
item.description:
Run as runbook on the Collections page runs that collection’s lines in the order shown, in the current tab. Favourites run first, then the rest, which is the same order Pro termorq-cli run uses.

flowchart LR
 shelf[("Collection")]:::store
 fav["Favourites,\nthen the rest"]:::step
 stepn["Shell, endpoint,\nor tool"]:::out
 looked{"Check"}:::gate
 capture["Capture\nname = $.path"]:::step
 halt(["Stop"]):::exit

 shelf --> fav --> stepn --> looked
 looked --> capture --> stepn
 looked --> halt

 classDef store fill:#134e4a,stroke:#5eead4,stroke-width:2px,color:#f4fbfa
 classDef gate fill:#FFC131,stroke:#b45309,stroke-width:2px,color:#1a1404
 classDef step fill:#0f766e,stroke:#99f6e4,stroke-width:2px,color:#f4fbfa
 classDef out fill:#155e75,stroke:#67e8f9,stroke-width:2px,color:#f4fbfa
 classDef exit fill:#9f1239,stroke:#fecdd3,stroke-width:2px,color:#fff1f2
 linkStyle 0,1,2,3,4 stroke:#5eead4,stroke-width:2.5px
 linkStyle 5 stroke:#fb7185,stroke-width:2.5px
